title: I made a game about cleaning polluted lakes and bringing them back to life
author: Embarrassed_Text_347
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I recently released **Clean Wake**, a free mobile game where you clean up polluted lakes and slowly restore them back to life.

You start with a small boat collecting trash, but as you progress, you can upgrade your equipment, hire workers to help clean, unlock better gear, and travel to new environments.

One of the best parts of the game is watching each lake transform from a polluted mess into a clean, vibrant environment as you clear out the trash. You bring the surrounding community and animals back to life.

There's also equipment progression, cosmetics, different environments to explore, and plenty of upgrades to work toward.

**There are also ZERO forced ads. So you can play for free forever and never watch a single ad.**

**ANDROID:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gubestudios.cleanwake](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gubestudios.cleanwake)  
**IOS:** [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clean-wake-water-cleanup-game/id6832360665](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clean-wake-water-cleanup-game/id6832360665)

I'm looking for feedback on the gameplay, especially whether the cleaning and progression feel satisfying or if there's anything you'd change to make it more enjoyable.

Also, since I know everyone here is posting their own apps, some feedback about the store page would be helpful.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Embarrassed_Text_347 please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.
